status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Engine 1.1.0-rc.1 and the site comparison are inlined into server.mjs. The engine is an unpublished candidate: npm serves 1.0.0 under the latest tag, which computes the same values, and the bundle is built from the candidate's archive, whose SHA-256 is below. The adapter is an unpublished candidate. Bundling keeps one copy of the comparison rules.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

computeApi.note: The hosted compute API's parsers and positions, events, sky-fact and time calculations, inlined into server.mjs, so get_positions, find_events, check_sky_fact and resolve_birth_time return what POST https://zodiacs.org/api/v1/positions, /events, /sky-fact and /time return for the same request. The first three take no zone; resolve_birth_time reads its zone with the engine's geo entry and the zone histories the engine ships, which server.mjs carries.

places.note: The site's birthplace index, which scripts/build-cities.mjs builds and the site's calculators fetch, inlined into server.mjs for search_places with the ranking the site's search uses.

timeAtlas.name: Zodiacs.org historical time atlas
timeAtlas.note: The engine repository's atlas data, copied byte for byte, and its resolver (atlas/tools/lib.mjs, MIT) with only its loader changed, inlined into server.mjs for resolve_birth_time's atlasPlace.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard. The record and receipt schemas are drafts.

changedSince: 0.1.0-rc.25 bundles engine 1.1.0-rc.1, an unpublished candidate, in place of 1.0.0, with 1.0.0's values. A record that calculate_natal_chart writes carries the engine's sixth conventions set and lists, as receipt.conventionIds, the ids of the Zodiacs conventions registry that it and its result name. Its envelope requires the feature convention-ids, so adapters up to rc.24, which bundle 1.0.0 or earlier engines, refuse it as unsupported_feature. compare_calculation_records reports a difference in that key as how the records list their ids, not as different conventions. The compute API receipts that get_positions, find_events, check_sky_fact and resolve_birth_time carry list, as conventionIds, the ids their own fields name. get_capabilities labels the engine an unpublished candidate, and zodiacs://conventions lists the sixth set. Older archives remain unchanged. The adapter itself is still not on npm.
